newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Teltron sacks managing director after probe.
newsitem.headline: Teltron sacks managing director after probe.

text.p: Electronics group Teltron said on Tuesday it had sacked its managing director Christopher Niehaus after a disciplinary inquiry.
He was suspended last month pending the outcome of the probe.
The company said the investigation had not shown anything that might materially affect the financial situation of Teltron as disclosed in its pre-listing statement.
The company, a subsidiary of Premier Group Ltd, was floated on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange in May this year.
"Furthermore the board does not anticipate that the activities unveiled will have any adverse impact on current trading performance and expectations within the Teltron Group," the statement said.

Leon Schonknecht, currently managing director of Premier subsidiary United Pharmaceutical Holdings (Pty) Ltd, has been appointed Teltron's new managing director and a director of Premier. -- Johannesburg newsroom -27-11-482-1003.
